description:
Cast Wall of Stolen Identity by paying {3}{U}.
Wall of Stolen Identity enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Wall of Stolen Identity triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.
